svg.title: Every Page Links Out
svg.desc: Sketch in perspective: a wooden fingerpost stands where two paths cross, with a blank, hatched board at its top. Below the board, four arms point in four directions. On them, in turn, are a small grid, a card with a circle on it, a closed book, and a thread circle. A mannequin stands at the foot of the post, pointing up at the arms. The post's blank board is a single page on the site, the focus. The crossing paths are where readers arrive, often straight from a search. The arms are the page's links, the solution: the grid points to the table, the card to a pattern the page introduces or applies, the book to the sources it draws on, and the thread circle to the other pieces in its thread. The figure is a reader who has just arrived and can see where to go next. The metaphor: a page as a signpost, not a dead end.
